_comment: Global hotkeys for capture mode, tried in order - the first that registers wins,
and any extras that also register work too. They are GLOBAL, so whatever you put
here is swallowed system-wide while the collector is running in capture mode.
That is why the defaults are Alt+Q/W/E and not bare Q/W/E: a bare letter would
stop that letter reaching game chat, and toggle recording every time you typed it.
Alt+ chords sit under the same fingers but never fire while typing.
Bare letters ARE allowed if you accept that trade-off - set "toggle": ["W"].
Label mode unregisters all of these so they cannot fight the box editor.
